description: Installation of sliding doors to replace the existing door and windows, installation of balustrades to replace part of the brick wall at first floor level to the rear elevation; installation of sliding doors and 2no enlarged windows to replace the existing door and windows at ground floor level to the rear elevation; installation of an air conditioning unit above the roof of ground floor rear back addition; installation of a sky lantern above the roof of ground floor back addition; alterations to the roof of ground floor side extension to include the installation of new rooflights and infilling of part of the glazed rooflight with new roof covering; restoration of the rear brickwork, replacing the existing render to reinstate materials consistent with the original building; installation of an electric vehicle charging point to front side boundary wall (revised description).
